methodologyNotes: Covers whole-house and point-of-use on-demand (tankless) residential water heaters sold at a published US price, spanning natural-gas, propane, and electric units. Excludes conventional tank-style storage heaters, heat-pump (hybrid) tanks, and commercial rack/manifold systems. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. fuelType is an enum: natural-gas, propane, or electric (dual NG/LP units listed by their primary catalog listing). maxFlowRateGpm is the manufacturer maximum hot-water output in US gallons per minute; it is a peak figure at a nominal temperature rise, NOT a fixed-rise rating. maxBtuPerHour is rated gas input in BTU per hour; null for electric units. powerInputKw is rated electrical input in kilowatts; null for gas units. uniformEnergyFactor is the DOE Uniform Energy Factor (UEF), dimensionless, higher is better; null if not disclosed. condensingType is an enum: condensing, non-condensing, or electric. minActivationFlowGpm is the minimum flow in GPM required to fire the burner or heating element. ventType is an enum: pvc, stainless-steel, concentric, or none (ventless electric). maxTempF is the maximum output setpoint in degrees Fahrenheit. heatExchangerWarrantyYrs is the residential heat-exchanger warranty in years. wifiEnabled is a boolean: true only if native Wi-Fi/app control is built in, false if it requires an add-on module. weightLbs is unit dry weight in pounds.
